help.PASS_OK: Any pass that reaches a teammate.
help.PASS_LOST: A pass intercepted, overhit or out of play. It also counts as a loss.
help.PROG: A pass or carry of at least 10 m towards the opponent's goal. For a pass, also tag Pass.
help.LINE: The ball gets past a line of at least two opponents and reaches a teammate who controls it. Replaces Progressive, never both.
help.FINAL3: Ball controlled in the last 35 metres, once per entry.
help.BOX: Ball controlled in the opponent's box, from a pass received or a carry.
help.SHOT_IN: A shot that makes the keeper act or goes in. The shot is added automatically.
help.GOAL: A goal for us: the shot and the shot on target are added automatically, the score updates.
help.FIX2: A dribble or carry that draws two opponents, and we keep the ball.
help.SWITCH: The ball changes side after the block has been drawn. For a pass, also tag Pass.
help.LOSS: Any loss that is not a pass: duel, dribble, failed first touch.
help.REGAIN5: Ball won back within 5 seconds of a lost pass or a loss.
help.REGAIN: Interception, tackle, keeper save, ball given back. Within 5 s of a loss, it counts as Won back 5 s.
help.OPP_GOAL: A goal by the opponent: their shot is added, the score updates.
help.OPP_PASS: Completed pass by the opponent (for possession share).
help.OPP_PASS_LOST: Pass lost by the opponent (for possession share).
help.OPP_FINAL3: Opponent entry into our final third (for field tilt).

progression.name: Progression
progression.what: Does the ball move forward? Progressive passes and carries and broken lines, relative to passes attempted. Benchmark: 35 progressive actions per 100 passes score 20 points.

penetration.name: Penetration
penetration.what: Does the ball get where goals are scored? Entries into the final third and the box (counted double), per possession. Benchmark: one per possession scores 20 points.

fixation.name: Fixation
fixation.what: Do we draw opponents to free a teammate? Dribbles or carries that pin two opponents and switches after a fixation, per possession. Benchmark: one fixation action every four possessions.

reprise.name: Regain
reprise.what: Do we react to losing the ball? Balls won back within 5 seconds, relative to all losses (lost passes included). Benchmark: 4 regains for 10 losses.

controle.name: Control
controle.what: Do we keep the ball safely? The conservation rate K: the share of our possession actions (passes and losses on the ball) that keep it. 0 points at 55%, 10 at 70%, 20 at 85% and above.

counts.lossOnBall: on the ball or in duels

hub.title: Analysis
hub.subtitle: Tag a match from the touchline or from video. {{app}} turns it into the Indice Njangi and a summary of your playing philosophy.
hub.toTagEmpty: No upcoming match. Create the next match to tag it live from the touchline.
hub.analysedEmpty: No analysed match yet. Go live at your next match: every tap counts.
hub.trendOne: The curve appears from the second analysed match.
hub.averagesHint: Over {{n}} analysed match(es). The codes are added up, then the Indice is computed: never the average of the matches.
hub.whatTitle: The Indice Njangi, in two sentences
hub.what1: Possession percentage lies: a team can have the ball and never go anywhere. The Indice Njangi measures, out of 100, whether your team possessed with purpose.
hub.what2: It adds up five sub-indices out of 20: Progression, Penetration, Fixation, Regain and Control. They are internal benchmarks of the Njangi method, to calibrate on your own matches.
hub.videoBody: Open a match video on your device, tag the actions, draw on the frame and export your clips.
hub.noTeamBody: Analysis is built on a team and its matches. Give it a name, {{app}} prepares the rest.
hub.freeLimitTitle: Unlimited live tagging is in Coach Pro
hub.freeLimitBody: Your free plan includes one live-tagged match. Move to Coach Pro to tag all your matches.
hub.trendHint: {{n}} matches analysed. Tap a point to open its report.
hub.trendNone: Analyse a first match, live or on video: its score will appear here.
hub.nextHint: Two halves of {{half}} min. The phone stays awake while you tag.

live.title: Live
live.logEmpty: No tags yet. Every tap shows up here, newest first.
live.helpIntro: One tap per action, without looking down for long. The clock, the tags and the score are saved on the device with every tap, even with no network.
live.helpLoss: After a Loss or a Pass lost, a 5 second ring appears on Ball won: a tap inside the window counts as Won back 5 s. Count under your breath: one, two, three, four, five.
live.helpPlayer: After a tap, shirt numbers show for 2.5 seconds: tap a number to credit the action, or ignore it.
live.endBody: The match is marked as finished with this score, and the report opens. You can still fix tags from the log.
live.doneBanner: Match finished: new tags complete the report.
live.attributionHint: Show shirt numbers after each tap.
live.notFoundBody: This match does not exist or was deleted.
live.offline: Offline: everything is saved on the device.
live.oppModeHint: Adds their passes and their entries into our final third: possession share and field tilt in the report.
live.autoAdded: Shot and shot on target added
live.helpAuto: A Goal also adds Shot and Shot on target; a Shot on target adds Shot. Undo removes the whole group.
live.keysLine: Shortcuts: Space, 1 to 9, F S L K R A B, U, J, H

summary.headline: {{label}}: {{total}} out of 100

ball.control0: The ball rarely stayed with us: {{passes}} passes attempted, {{acc}}% completion and a {{k}}% conservation rate.
ball.control1: The ball circulated: {{passes}} passes attempted, {{acc}}% completion, a {{k}}% conservation rate.
ball.control2: The ball circulated well: {{passes}} passes attempted, {{acc}}% completion, a {{k}}% conservation rate.
ball.prog0: But too often it went round without moving forward: only {{pct}}% of passes progressed or broke a line ({{lines}} lines broken).
ball.prog1: It moved forward at times: {{pct}}% of passes progressed or broke a line ({{lines}} lines broken).
ball.prog2: And it moved forward with purpose: {{pct}}% of passes progressed or broke a line ({{lines}} lines broken).
ball.conclNoPurpose: The pot went round, but it was going nowhere: every pass must be asked what it prepares.
ball.conclPurpose: The ball travelled, and it knew where it was going.
ball.conclDirect: The team looked forward straight away, at the cost of losses: sometimes you have to breathe before you accelerate.
ball.conclStruggle: Possession was hard: the priority is to keep the ball long enough to give it a direction.
ball.conclBalanced: A possession game in progress, which needs to become more consistent.

zone.beforeFinal: Play mostly stalled before the final third: {{final3}} entries for {{poss}} possessions.
zone.edgeBox: Play stalled at the edge of the box: {{final3}} final third entries, but only {{box}} into the box.
zone.inBox: The team got into the box ({{box}} times) without finishing enough: {{shots}} shots.
zone.finishing: The chances came ({{shots}} shots), but finishing lacked accuracy: {{shotsIn}} on target.
zone.fluent: The path to goal was fluent: {{final3}} final third entries, {{box}} into the box, {{shots}} shots with {{shotsIn}} on target.
zone.fix0: Little fixation: play rarely drew two opponents to free a teammate ({{fix}} fixation actions, {{sw}} switches).
zone.fix1: Fixation actions ({{fix}}) and switches ({{sw}}) sometimes created space on the other side.
zone.fix2: Fixation actions ({{fix}}) and switches ({{sw}}) regularly created overloads on the other side.

loss.none: No loss tagged: the reaction to losing the ball could not be measured.
loss.base: After {{losses}} losses, the team won the ball back within 5 seconds {{r5}} times ({{pct}}%).
loss.lvl0: The reaction was slow: too often we watched the opponent break away.
loss.lvl1: The counter-press is there, but it is not yet collective.
loss.lvl2: The counter-press was collective and fast: the ball came back quickly.

compare.up: Compared with the previous match, the Indice goes from {{prev}} to {{cur}} (+{{d}}), mainly thanks to {{sub}} (+{{sd}}).
compare.down: Compared with the previous match, the Indice goes from {{prev}} to {{cur}} ({{d}}), mainly because of {{sub}} ({{sd}}).
compare.flat: The Indice is stable compared with the previous match ({{prev}} then {{cur}}).

strength.progression: Progression ({{v}}/20): {{pct}}% of passes moved play forward, with {{lines}} lines broken.
strength.penetration: Penetration ({{v}}/20): {{final3}} final third entries and {{box}} into the box.
strength.fixation: Fixation ({{v}}/20): {{fix}} fixation actions and {{sw}} switches to play on the other side.
strength.reprise: Regain ({{v}}/20): {{pct}}% of losses followed by a regain within 5 seconds.
strength.controle: Control ({{v}}/20): {{k}}% of our possession actions kept the ball.
strength.goals: Efficiency: {{goals}} goal(s) from {{shotsIn}} shot(s) on target.
strength.shotsIn: Accuracy: {{shotsIn}} shots on target out of {{shots}}.
strength.effort: The will to play: {{n}} actions tagged, the team wanted the ball.

correction.progression: Progression ({{v}}/20): too many passes without direction. Look for the free man beyond the first line, facing play.
correction.penetration: Penetration ({{v}}/20): get into the final third and the box more often, through the half-space.
correction.fixation: Fixation ({{v}}/20): carry the ball to draw two opponents, then switch to the side you have freed.
correction.reprise: Regain ({{v}}/20): when we lose the ball, the nearest players attack it together for 5 seconds.
correction.controle: Control ({{v}}/20): too many losses. Offer angles, take an oriented first touch, play before the contact.
correction.shots: Finishing: {{shotsIn}} shots on target out of {{shots}}. Shoot from the finishing zone, the width of the goal area out to just beyond the penalty spot.
correction.oppShots: Rest defence: the opponent had {{n}} shots. Keep 3 + 2 players behind the ball while we attack.
correction.keep: Hold this level for the whole match: compare the first and second halves on the timeline.

objective.progression: Make at least {{target}}% of passes progress or break a line (today {{cur}}%).
objective.penetration: Get into the box at least {{target}} times in a match (today {{cur}}).
objective.fixation: Achieve at least {{target}} fixation actions or switches after a fixation (today {{cur}}).
objective.reprise: Win the ball back within 5 seconds after at least {{target}}% of losses (today {{cur}}%).
objective.intention: Main intention of the week: {{intention}}, announced at the start of every session and rewarded by the rules.

video.title: Video analysis
video.subtitle: Open a match video on your device, tag the actions at the right moment, draw on the frame and export your clips.
video.projectTitlePh: E.g. Lionceaux v Requins, second half
video.emptyBody: Film with a phone and a tripod, then open the file here. The video stays on your device: {{app}} only saves your tags and drawings.
video.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and its tags?
video.pickHint: Choose a video file on this device (MP4 or WebM). It is not uploaded anywhere.
video.repickHint: To save memory, {{app}} does not keep the video. Reopen the same file to find your tags at the right moment.
video.otherFile: This file is called "{{got}}", the project expects "{{want}}". Tags will be placed on this video.
video.clipsEmpty: No tags. Play the video and tap a code at the right moment.
video.drawHint: Pause the video to draw on the frame.
video.imageSaved: Image saved on the tag at {{t}}
video.keys: Keyboard: Space play or pause, arrows 5 s, comma and period frame by frame, D draw, N note. The codes use the same keys as live tagging (1 to 9, F S L K R A B).
video.notFoundBody: This project does not exist or was deleted.
video.notVideo: This file is not a video.
video.drawHelp: Draw on the frame with a finger or the mouse. "Save the image" attaches it to the selected tag, or creates a note at this moment.
video.tagHint: The tag lands at the moment shown by the video.
video.newHint: Next, open the video file from this device. It is never sent over the internet.

film.title: Film
film.body: A phone on a tripod, up high, level with the halfway line. The whole pitch in frame.

tag.title: Tag
tag.body: The same codes as live tagging, placed at the right moment of the video. The Indice updates as you go.

draw.title: Show
draw.body: Pause, draw arrows and circles, save the image. Five clips are enough for the video session.
